children: ExxonMobil has concluded a preliminary investigation into a power outage Sept. 13 at its 275,000 b/d Joliet refinery in Channahon, Ill., according to a company update.

An ExxonMobil spokesperson issued a statement Thursday saying, "We've concluded a preliminary investigation of the Sept. 13 power outage in collaboration with ComEd. The source of the outage was found on ComEd's primary and secondary power lines feeding into the Joliet refinery. This issue has been resolved in order to fully restore power to the refinery. Our team continues to work hard to safely restart our facility and minimize impact to customers."

Since the reported outage, Chicago Gasoline and ULSD basis prices have surged, posting a 3ct premium for Sept. 11 to a 42.25ct premium Thursday for Chicago Comprehensive 11.5-lb September Cycle 3 CBOB. On the distillate side, the average differential moved up from a 19.75ct discount on Sept. 11 to a 57.5ct premium Thursday for Chicago Comprehensive September Cycle 3 ULSD.
The anticipated restart will come as a relief as futures contract prices have also seen a steady increase between Sept. 11 and Sept. 17 of around 17cts for RBOB and 19cts for ULSD.
